passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × almeidae Vila-Viçosa, Capelo, P.Alves & F.M.Vázquez.
The native range of this hybrid is Portugal to W. Spain. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is Q. pseudococcifera × Q. rotundifolia.
